user.title: Log in to PostNord
user.description:
PostNord's login finishes in the PostNord app, so its last address is copied over by hand.

1. Open an empty browser tab and press **F12**. On the **Network** tab, turn on **Preserve log** (in Firefox **Persist Logs** under the gear).
2. Copy [the login link]({login_url}) (right-click › Copy link), open it in that tab and log in.
3. Type `code=` in the Network filter and copy the address that starts with `com.postnord.app://redirect?code=`. If it isn't listed, it's in the **Location** header of the last `account.postnord.com` request.

data_description.redirect_url: Paste it and continue within a few minutes. The code in it works only once.

data_description.pickup_code: A code for collecting the package. Off by default as this is sensitive data.

error.invalid_auth: PostNord didn't accept the login. The code expires in minutes and works only once. Log in again with the link and paste the new address straight away.
error.no_code: That isn't the login address. Copy the whole address that starts with com.postnord.app://redirect?code=.
